zh: 网格可达 10^9×10^9，不能逐个枚举窗口；但每个黑格最多属于 4 个 2×2 窗口，含黑格的窗口总共不超过 4k 个。
只统计被黑格触及的窗口：对每个黑格枚举包含它的至多 4 个窗口（用左上角标识），累计每个窗口里的黑格数；没有被触及的窗口黑格数都是 0。
对黑格 (x, y)，窗口左上角取 (x−1 或 x, y−1 或 y)，只保留 0 ≤ i < rows−1 且 0 ≤ j < cols−1 的；用哈希表（或排序后数相同项）得到每个窗口的黑格数并按 1..4 计数；0 类的数量为 (rows−1)(cols−1) 减去被触及的窗口数，全部用 64 位整数。
en: The grid can be 10^9×10^9, so windows cannot be enumerated one by one; but each black cell lies in at most 4 windows of size 2×2, so at most 4k windows contain any black cell.

Only count the windows touched by black cells: for each black cell enumerate the at most 4 windows containing it (identified by their top-left corner) and tally the black cells per window; every untouched window has zero black cells.

For black cell (x, y), the window corners are (x−1 or x, y−1 or y), kept only when 0 ≤ i < rows−1 and 0 ≤ j < cols−1; a hash map (or sorting and counting equal keys) gives each window's black count, which you tally for 1..4; the zero class is (rows−1)(cols−1) minus the number of touched windows, all in 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Each black cell belongs to at most four 2×2 windows, so only accumulate the windows touched by black cells; every other window has zero black cells.

## Proof of correctness

Any 2×2 window containing at least one black cell is enumerated by some black cell inside it, and its frequency in the dictionary equals exactly the number of black cells it contains. Windows that never appear contain no black cells, so the count of the zero class is the total number of windows minus the size of the dictionary.

## Complexity

O(k) time and O(k) space.

## Source and additions

https://oamaster.com/docs/companies/koddi#4-count-2x2-submatrices-by-black-cell-count; the statement is explicit; this site adds the coordinate ranges, the distinctness of black cells, and the input protocol.
